text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore, Curriculum Planning and Development Division. Mathematics Syllabus Primary One to Six (implementation starting with the 2021 Primary One cohort; updated October 2025). Fractions: P2 p. 33, P3 p. 35, P4 p. 37, P5 p. 41.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司：《小学一至六年级数学课程纲要》（自 2021 年小一新生起实施；2025 年 10 月更新版）。分数：小二第 33 页、小三第 35 页、小四第 37 页、小五第 41 页。

note.en: The only source for what each step covers; the syllabus lines in the lesson are quoted from it. Pages checked 2026-10-11 against the PDF: Fractions P2 p. 33, P3 p. 35, P4 p. 37, P5 p. 41; Skemp's relational understanding p. 20; applies to P6 from 2026, p. 30.
note.zh: 每一步学什么，只以这份课纲为准；课里的课纲条目照原文引用。2026-10-11 对照 PDF 核对页码：分数小二第 33 页、小三第 35 页、小四第 37 页、小五第 41 页；Skemp 的关系性理解见第 20 页；2026 年起也适用于小六，见第 30 页。

text.en: Ministry of Education Singapore: primary syllabuses page, and the approved textbook list.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部：小学课程纲要页面，以及批准教材目录。

note.en: Version check of S1 and the textbook series in use (https://www.moe.gov.sg/education-in-sg/approved-textbook-list). Links checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 用于核对 S1 的版本和在用的教材系列（批准教材目录：https://www.moe.gov.sg/education-in-sg/approved-textbook-list）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: TIMSS 2015 Encyclopedia. Singapore: The Mathematics Curriculum in Primary and Lower Secondary Grades. TIMSS & PIRLS International Study Center, Boston College.
text.zh: 《TIMSS 2015 百科》新加坡条目：小学与初中的数学课程。波士顿学院 TIMSS & PIRLS 国际研究中心。

note.en: Describes the Concrete-Pictorial-Abstract (C-P-A) approach used in Singapore primary and lower secondary mathematics. Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 说明新加坡小学和初中数学采用的「具体—图像—抽象」（C-P-A）教学法。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: Ng, S. F. & Lee, K. (2009). The model method: Singapore children's tool for representing and solving algebraic word problems. Journal for Research in Mathematics Education 40(3), 282–313.
text.zh: Ng, S. F. 与 Lee, K.（2009）：模型法——新加坡儿童表示和解决代数文字题的工具。《数学教育研究杂志》第 40 卷第 3 期，282–313 页。

note.en: The bar model: part–whole and comparison models (steps 10 and 11). DOI checked 2026-10-11. MOE (2009) The Singapore Model Method for Learning Mathematics is the companion book; not yet checked against a library copy.
note.zh: 模型图：部分—整体模型和比较模型（第 10、11 步）。DOI 于 2026-10-11 核对。配套读物是教育部 2009 年出版的《新加坡数学模型法》，尚未借阅原书核对。

text.en: Siegler, R. et al. (2010). Developing Effective Fractions Instruction for Kindergarten Through 8th Grade (NCEE 2010-4039). Institute of Education Sciences, What Works Clearinghouse.
text.zh: Siegler, R. 等（2010）：《幼儿园至八年级的有效分数教学》（NCEE 2010-4039）。美国教育科学研究院「有效教学资料库」。

note.en: Recommendation 2: help students see fractions as numbers, using number lines as a central representational tool; recommendation 3: help students understand why procedures for computing with fractions make sense. Basis for using the number line throughout (a representation, not a separate syllabus line). Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 建议 2：帮助学生把分数看作数，以数轴为中心表示工具；建议 3：帮助学生理解分数计算方法为什么成立。全课贯穿使用数轴的依据（数轴是表示法，不是单独的课纲条目）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: Ni, Y. & Zhou, Y.-D. (2005). Teaching and learning fraction and rational numbers: the origins and implications of whole number bias. Educational Psychologist 40(1), 27–52.
text.zh: Ni, Y. 与 Zhou, Y.-D.（2005）：分数与有理数的教与学——整数偏差的来源与启示。《教育心理学家》第 40 卷第 1 期，27–52 页。

note.en: Whole-number bias: a bigger denominator read as a bigger fraction; adding tops and bottoms. The distractors in steps 05, 06, 09, 10 and practice Q3, Q6, Q7 follow it. The DOI resolves to the publisher's page (2026-10-11), which blocks automated reading.
note.zh: 整数偏差：以为分母大分数就大；把分子、分母分别相加。第 05、06、09、10 步和练习第 3、6、7 题的干扰项依据它设计。DOI 可解析到出版方页面（2026-10-11），该页面拒绝自动访问。

text.en: Centre for Neuroscience in Education, University of Cambridge: What makes learning fractions so hard? (Part 2).
text.zh: 剑桥大学教育神经科学中心：分数为什么难学？（第二部分）

note.en: Children often think a fraction with a bigger denominator is bigger, an example of whole-number bias (step 05, practice Q8). Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 孩子常以为分母大的分数就大，这是整数偏差的一例（第 05 步、练习第 8 题）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: OISE Robertson Program, University of Toronto (2022): Whole number bias and 3 misconceptions about fractions in junior math.
text.zh: 多伦多大学安大略教育研究院 Robertson 项目（2022）：整数偏差与小学分数的三个误解。

note.en: Teacher-facing descriptions of three misconceptions: a bigger denominator means a bigger fraction; procedure over meaning; fractions with different denominators seen as unrelated. Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 面向教师的三个误解：分母大分数就大；只套算法不顾意义；以为分母不同的分数互不相干。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: Australian Association of Mathematics Teachers, Top Drawer Teachers: Fractions, Misunderstandings, Number of parts only: teaching equal parts.
text.zh: 澳大利亚数学教师协会 Top Drawer：分数·误解·只数份数——教「平均分」。

note.en: The misunderstanding that only the number of parts decides a fraction; children should make the parts themselves and judge whether they are the same size, using irregular shapes too (step 01). Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 误以为只有份数决定分数；要让孩子自己分，并判断各份是否一样大，也要用不规则的形状（第 01 步）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: NCETM (National Centre for Excellence in the Teaching of Mathematics): Curriculum prioritisation in primary maths, Year 3 Unit 8, Unit fractions, and Unit 9, Non-unit fractions; Primary subject knowledge audit, Fractions, question 6.
text.zh: 英国国家数学教学卓越中心（NCETM）：小学数学课程重点，三年级第 8 单元「单位分数」与第 9 单元「非单位分数」；小学学科知识自查·分数·第 6 题。

note.en: Unit 8 outcomes: identify equal parts when they do not look the same; identify when unit fractions cannot be compared (steps 01 and 05, practice Q8). Unit 9 (https://ncetm.org.uk/classroom-resources/cp-year-3-unit-9-non-unit-fractions/): non-unit fractions are made of unit fractions (step 03). Audit question 6 (https://www.ncetm.org.uk/media/wzomk3ni/pska-frac-q6.pdf): a picture with 5 parts shaded and 7 not shaded as a trap for 5/7 (the part–part error, steps 02 and 03). Links checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 第 8 单元的目标：认出看起来不一样的相等部分；知道什么时候单位分数不能比较（第 01、05 步，练习第 8 题）。第 9 单元（https://ncetm.org.uk/classroom-resources/cp-year-3-unit-9-non-unit-fractions/）：非单位分数由几个单位分数组成（第 03 步）。自查第 6 题（https://www.ncetm.org.uk/media/wzomk3ni/pska-frac-q6.pdf）：涂 5 份、不涂 7 份的图，是 5/7 的陷阱（部分比部分的错误，第 02、03 步）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: Oak National Academy: Identify non-unit fractions (Key Stage 2 lesson).
text.zh: 英国 Oak 国家学院：认识非单位分数（第二学段课）。

note.en: Warns that pupils may count the unshaded parts for the denominator; count all the equal parts, and find the denominator before the numerator (steps 02 and 03). Link checked 2026-10-11; the page may move, so keep an archived copy.
note.zh: 提醒学生可能把没涂的份数当作分母；要数全部相等的部分，先找分母、再找分子（第 02、03 步）。链接于 2026-10-11 核对；该页面可能移动，需留存档。

text.en: Mitchell, A. & Horne, M. (2008). Fraction number line tasks and the additivity concept of length measurement. In M. Goos, R. Brown & K. Makar (Eds.), Navigating Currents and Charting Directions: Proceedings of the 31st annual conference of the Mathematics Education Research Group of Australasia (pp. 353–360). Brisbane: MERGA.
text.zh: Mitchell, A. 与 Horne, M.（2008）：分数数轴任务与长度测量的可加性概念。载于 Goos, M.、Brown, R.、Makar, K. 编《澳大拉西亚数学教育研究学会第 31 届年会论文集》，353–360 页。布里斯班：MERGA。

note.en: 'Counting lines, not spaces': Grade 6 children counted the marks on a number line, including the mark at zero, instead of the spaces between them (step 04, practice Q5). Replaces a commercial web page used in the draft. Paper read 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 「数线不数段」：六年级孩子数数轴上的刻度线（连 0 那条也数），而不是数线与线之间的段（第 04 步、练习第 5 题）。替换了草稿里的一个商业网页。2026-10-11 已读原文。

text.en: Pearn, C. & Stephens, M. (2004). Why you have to probe to discover what Year 8 students really think about fractions. In I. Putt, R. Faragher & M. McLean (Eds.), Mathematics Education for the Third Millennium: Towards 2010. Proceedings of the 27th annual conference of the Mathematics Education Research Group of Australasia (pp. 430–437). Townsville: MERGA.
text.zh: Pearn, C. 与 Stephens, M.（2004）：为什么要追问才能知道八年级学生对分数的真实想法。载于 Putt, I.、Faragher, R.、McLean, M. 编《澳大拉西亚数学教育研究学会第 27 届年会论文集》，430–437 页。汤斯维尔：MERGA。

note.en: Gap thinking: comparing fractions by the gap between top and bottom or the parts missing from a whole (p. 431, p. 434); one student judged two thirds and three quarters equal because each is one away from a whole (p. 435). Used for step 09 and practice Q8. Paper read 2026-10-11 (PDF on the MERGA site).
note.zh: 差距思维：按分子与分母之差，或按离一个整体还差几份来比较分数（第 431、434 页）；一名学生认为三分之二和四分之三一样大，因为都差一份到一个整体（第 435 页）。用于第 09 步和练习第 8 题。2026-10-11 已读原文（MERGA 网站上的 PDF）。

text.en: Skemp, R. R. (1976). Relational understanding and instrumental understanding. Mathematics Teaching 77, 20–26.
text.zh: Skemp, R. R.（1976）：关系性理解与工具性理解。《数学教学》第 77 期，20–26 页。

note.en: Cited by S1 (p. 20): knowing the why, not just the what and how. Every feedback line in the lesson says why.
note.zh: S1 第 20 页引用的观点：「知其所以然」，不只是知道做什么、怎么做。课里每一句反馈都讲为什么。

text.en: Reinhold, F., Obersteiner, A., Hoch, S., Hofer, S. I. & Reiss, K. (2020). The interplay between the natural number bias and fraction magnitude processing in low-achieving students. Frontiers in Education 5, 29.
text.zh: Reinhold, F.、Obersteiner, A.、Hoch, S.、Hofer, S. I. 与 Reiss, K.（2020）：低成就学生的自然数偏差与分数大小加工的相互作用。《教育前沿》第 5 卷，第 29 篇。

note.en: Natural number bias in comparing fraction sizes. Title and authors confirmed from the publisher's page; link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 比较分数大小时的自然数偏差。题名与作者据出版方页面确认；链接于 2026-10-11 核对。

text.en: Textbook series on the MOE approved list (for the usual order of topics only, not copied): Marshall Cavendish My Pals Are Here! Maths; Shaping Maths.
text.zh: 教育部批准目录上的教材系列（只参考通常的教学顺序，不照抄）：Marshall Cavendish《My Pals Are Here! Maths》、《Shaping Maths》。

note.en: Questions, pictures and wording in this lesson are our own.
note.zh: 本课的题目、插图和措辞都是自己写的。

text.en: MOE iwant2study (Singapore Student Learning Space interactives), e.g. Compare fractions.
text.zh: 教育部 iwant2study（新加坡学生学习平台的互动资源），如「比较分数」。

note.en: Typical forms of fraction interactives, for reference. Link checked 2026-10-11.
note.zh: 分数互动的常见形式，仅作参考。链接于 2026-10-11 核对。
